hypotheses.reasoning: Once template-svc-1 restarted (capacity 3/4), the remaining instances should have been able to handle the load. Instead, notification-svc retried every 503 immediately with backoff disabled, which pushed template-svc traffic to 3–4x normal. template-svc then shed load with 503s, which fed more retries, so the 503s at the gateway never recovered. The status-poller timeouts against legacy-inventory are an unrelated red herring.
Another reading is that template-svc capacity was simply too small, but the request volume reached 4x baseline because of the retries.

verdict.recommendedAction: Turn on exponential backoff with jitter and a retry budget/circuit breaker in notification-svc TemplateClient. Temporarily throttle retries or scale out template-svc until the backlog drains. Check why template-svc-1 failed its liveness probe.
